mapper.select: select sm.perms from sys_menu sm inner join sys_role_menu srm on sm.id = srm.menu_id where srm.role_id = #{roleId} and sm.perms is not null

select distinct m.id, m.parent_id, m.name, m.redirect, m.component, m.icon, m.sort, m.title, m.target, m.active, m.type, m.path, m.is_hide, m.is_full, m.is_affix, m.is_keep_alive, m.tag, m.perms from sys_menu m inner join sys_role_menu rm on m.id = rm.menu_id where rm.role_id in
#{roleId}
